title: Fast and Easy Method to Culture and Obtain Large Populations of Male Nematodes
author: Cailloce, Husson, et al.

steps.title: Prepare NGM agar plates
steps.instruction: Make NGM agar (145 mm diameter) containing per litre: NaCl 3 g, agar 25 g, cholesterol 5 mg, CaCl₂ 1 mM, MgSO₄ 1 mM, K₂HPO₄/KH₂PO₄ buffer 25 mM (pH 6), and peptone 20 g. Pour into 145 mm plates.

steps.title: Prepare NA22 bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate NA22 E. coli in 2×YT medium (NaCl 5 g L⁻¹, tryptone 16 g L⁻¹, yeast extract 10 g L⁻¹) and grow at 37 °C, 200 rpm. Harvest and concentrate 25‑fold (NA22 25×). Do not exceed 500 mL culture in a 2 L flask.

steps.title: Seed plates with NA22
steps.instruction: Spread 1 mL of the NA22 25× suspension evenly over each NGM plate. Incubate the seeded plates at room temperature for at least 48 h before use.

steps.title: Grow synchronized worm population
steps.instruction: Place the desired C. elegans strain on the seeded plates and incubate at 15 °C (preferred for high male purity) until the worms reach the L4 stage, then continue for an additional 30 h so that the population is synchronous adults.

steps.title: Collect and wash worms
steps.instruction: Harvest the worms from the plates with M9 buffer. Wash the collected worms twice by resuspending in fresh M9 and allowing the worms to settle.

steps.title: First filtration (20 µm strainer)
steps.instruction: Transfer the washed worm suspension onto filter set 1, which contains a 20 µm strainer. Wash the strainer with 40 mL M9 to remove residual bacteria, most embryos, and L1‑L3 larvae.

steps.title: Second filtration (30 µm & 40 µm filters)
steps.instruction: Move the worms retained on the 20 µm strainer to filter set 2, which comprises a 40 µm cell strainer placed above a 30 µm membrane filter. Incubate for 40 min at room temperature. Three populations are obtained: (1) hermaphrodites retained by the 40 µm strainer, (2) a mixed population of males and hermaphrodites retained by the 30 µm membrane, and (3) males that pass through both filters.

steps.title: Third filtration (30 µm strainer)
steps.instruction: Collect the flow‑through (population #3, enriched males) and place it onto filter set 3, which contains a 30 µm strainer. Wash with 40 mL M9 to eliminate remaining L1‑L3 larvae and embryos. Optionally repeat the wash to increase purity.

steps.title: Recover final male population
steps.instruction: Remove the funnel from filter set 3 and gently rinse the 30 µm strainer to recover the worms retained on it. These worms constitute the final male‑enriched population (>90 % males).
